PSALM 120

. This is the first of fifteen Psalms (Psalms 120-134) entitled "A Song of Degrees" (--literally, "A song for the degrees"), or ascents. It seems most probable they were designed for the use of the people when going up (compare , ) to Jerusalem on the festival occasions (), three times a year. David appears as the author of four, Solomon of one (), and the other ten are anonymous, probably composed after the captivity. In this Psalm the writer acknowledges God's mercy, prays for relief from a malicious foe, whose punishment he anticipates, and then repeats his complaint.
